{{short description|German chemist and physicist}}
'''Richard Dronskowski''' (born 11 November 1961, in [[Brilon]]) is a German chemist and physicist. He is a full professor at the [[RWTH Aachen University]].

== Life ==
Dronskowski studied chemistry and physics at the [[University of Münster]] from 1981 to 1986.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|url=http://www.ssc.rwth-aachen.de/download/CV_Dronskowski_en.pdf|title=CV Dronskowski|website=www.ssc.rwth-aachen.de|access-date=2018-12-30}}</ref> He completed his chemistry diploma with [[Bernt Krebs]] and [[Arndt Simon]] in 1987.<ref name=":0" /> He finished his physics diploma with Ole Krogh Andersen and Johannes Pollmann in 1989.<ref name=":0" /> He received his doctorate under supervision of [[Arndt Simon]] at the [[University of Stuttgart]].<ref name=":0" /> From 1991 to 1992, he was a visiting scientist in the group of [[Roald Hoffmann]] at [[Cornell University]].<ref name=":1">{{Cite journal|date=2015|title=Richard Dronskowski|journal=Angewandte Chemie International Edition|volume=54|issue=31|pages=8872|doi=10.1002/anie.201502594|pmid=25851434|issn=1521-3773}}</ref> In 1995, he finished his [[habilitation]] at the [[University of Dortmund]]. Since 1997, he is a full professor at the [[RWTH Aachen University]].<ref name=":0" />

== Research ==
His research focuses on the following topics:<ref name=":1" />

* solid-state chemistry
* quantum chemistry
* nitrides
* carbodiimides
* guanidinates
* intermetallics
* steel
* phase-change materials
* chemical bonding (e.g., Crystal Orbital Hamilton Populations)
* ''ab initio'' thermochemistry
* structural chemistry
* neutron diffraction

* 1996 Prize of [[Angewandte Chemie]]<ref name=":2">{{Cite web|url=http://hiam.szpt.edu.cn/index.php?menuID=4|title=Hoffmann Institute for Advanced Materials • GuestProfessor|website=hiam.szpt.edu.cn|access-date=2018-12-30}}</ref>
* 1997 Chemistry Lecturer Prize (Fonds der chemischen Industrie)<ref name=":1" />
* 2014 Distinguished Professorship ([[RWTH Aachen University]])<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.rwth-aachen.de/cms/root/Die_RWTH/Exzellenzinitiative/Zukunftskonzept/Massnahme_1_1_Staerkung_der_Naturwissensc/~dcbf/Distinguished_Professorships/|title=Distinguished Professorships – RWTH AACHEN UNIVERSITY – Deutsch|website=www.rwth-aachen.de|access-date=2018-12-30}}</ref>
